_comment: What stands on each kind of map site (#493). Per kind (a key of the map recipe's sites.kinds), its pieces: generator (a voxel kit generator's class name), at (metres from the site's centre: -z is the side the site's track leaves by, +x to its right), yaw (degrees, turning the piece from facing the track: 0 keeps its front, -z, toward the track; 90 turns it to face -x), params (the generator's own), and optionally choices (per parameter, a list the site's seed picks one from) and ranges (per parameter, [low, high] the seed picks between). mirror: the seed may flip the layout left to right. yard: packed dirt the world draws like a track, as rectangles [x0, z0, x1, z1] in the same frame as `at` (turned and mirrored with the pieces, cut to the footprint, so one reaching far to -z starts at the pad's edge where the track arrives); they must stay half a metre clear of every piece and must not overlap each other. A kind with no pieces is built by another module (water towers: towers). sink: metres every piece is set into its pad, so no gap shows where the pad's edge blends into the land. builds_per_frame: pieces put up each frame on a client while the map loads, nearest first (a server puts them all up at once). Every piece must stay inside its kind's footprint whichever side the track leaves by.
